title: Night shift
intake: Adult male, 58, found in bed at 07:40 by a neighbor.
context: The neighbor had a key and came to check when he didn't answer the door. No signs of a break-in.

procedures.name: Scene investigation
procedures.blurb: Where and how he was found, and who saw him last.

procedures.name: External exam
procedures.blurb: Examine the body region by region.

procedures.name: Toxicology (rush)
procedures.blurb: Drugs and alcohol in the blood.

findings.label: Window
findings.text: Bedroom window open; 38 °F outside overnight. Police closed it before the room was measured at 70 °F.
findings.meaning: The room was colder overnight than the 70 °F measured, so he cooled faster than the usual 1.5 °F per hour: about 1.8.

findings.label: Last seen
findings.text: Neighbor: they ate dinner together around 22:00, and he went home at 22:45, 'a little tired'.
findings.meaning: He was alive at 22:45, so he died after that.

findings.label: Medication
findings.text: Prescribed heart medication on the nightstand; the pill count matches the refill date.
findings.meaning: He was taking it as prescribed. No sign of an overdose or of intent to die.

findings.label: Rigor
findings.text: Stiff jaw and arms; legs still loose.
findings.meaning: Rigor is still spreading: roughly 3.5–8.5 hours.

findings.label: Livor
findings.text: Purple-red on the back; blanches under thumb pressure.
findings.meaning: Visible but not yet fixed: roughly 2–10 hours. It's on the back, matching how he lay.

findings.label: No injuries
findings.text: No injuries to the head, neck or hands. No pinpoint bleeds (petechiae) in the eyes.
findings.meaning: Nothing suggests an assault, an accident or smothering.

findings.label: Heart
findings.text: Left anterior descending coronary artery 90% narrowed; an old scar in the heart muscle.
findings.meaning: Severe coronary disease that can cause sudden death from a fatal heart rhythm, often with little warning.

findings.label: Lungs
findings.text: Lungs heavy with fluid; airway clear.
findings.meaning: Fluid backs up into the lungs when the heart fails to pump. The clear airway rules out choking.

findings.label: Stomach
findings.text: Partly digested meal in the stomach.
findings.meaning: Death came roughly 1–6 hours after dinner at 22:00. A rough clue.

findings.label: Toxicology
findings.text: Prescribed medication at a therapeutic level; no alcohol or other drugs.
findings.meaning: Taken as prescribed. Drugs did not cause this death.

person: Marcus Hale, 58, a retired bus mechanic who coached his niece's softball team.
story: He died at about 01:30 of a heart rhythm brought on by coronary artery disease he didn't know was this severe. The tiredness after dinner was likely an early warning.
